decisions.reason: The source also selects all approximately 40 App Store languages, but that effect is already fully represented by the candidate's existing message-71 MODIFY and RESUME Events.
Selecting the full language sets does not change the existing requirement to render RTL locales correctly or establish a new RTL behavior.
The localization language-count decision does not change the policy for removing unused Android permissions.
Although adding languages may affect package size, the source does not change the existing optimization goal or localized-asset strategy.
The selected App Store language coverage does not modify the existing iOS size-optimization goal or reusable tutorial-asset strategy.
The language-set choice does not alter iOS framework modernization, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
The localization coverage decision does not change Android platform compatibility, API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
App Store language coverage has no effect on the requirement to supply an iOS Privacy Manifest.
The localization language selection does not affect the expired signing-certificate problem or establish signing configuration state.
Selecting all supported localization languages does not change the established remote-content or reusable tutorial-image delivery strategies.
